root_cause_class: Role-specific slot tables had no universal centered fallback for large support/atomic objects.
The V31.0.0 collision rescue reused the same constrained slot system, so a one-object rescue could still be unsatisfiable.
Atomic companion selection could pair an atomic character with another atomic composite in one phase.
A monolithic card-level search spent search budget across temporally independent phases instead of decomposing the co-occurrence graph.
v31_0_1_architecture: Co-occurrence-component layout decomposition: non-simultaneous visual phases solve independently and may safely reuse screen coordinates.
Geometry-adaptive fallback anchors after semantic anchors; fallback placement does not invent semantic relationships.
Fit-derived scale candidates include a physical safe-frame solution rather than a fixed 0.60/0.54 floor dead-end.
Adaptive phase repacking retains primary and explicit relationship endpoints before decorative supports.
Bounded deterministic beam search prevents combinatorial explosion while retaining hard collision constraints.
Cross-phase pre-roll reduced from 0.20s to 0.06s to reduce motion-path overlap risk.
No project, script, topic, or scene-ID-specific branches.
quality_claim: No reference-parity claim is made before the real Windows/Premiere MP4 renders successfully and is compared against the locked references.
